title: Cannot see type of variables anymore (Rust)
body:
<!-- Your issue may already be reported!
Please search on the issue tracker before creating one. -->

### Reproduction steps

<!-- Ideally provide a key sequence and/or asciinema.org recording. --> 

Open a Rust crate:

```rust
fn main() {
    let a = 42;
    dbg!(a);
}
```

Use `Space+k` to get type informations:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7951708/154927237-7c3ecb16-98ff-4371-9b52-72e9c06057bb.png)

### Environment

- Platform: Linux, I have the same problem on the same commit on macOS <!--  macOS / Windows / Linux -->
- Terminal emulator: [kitty](https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty)
- Helix version: Commit 700058f4 <!--  'hx -V' if using a release, 'git describe' if building from master -->

I added a log file (taken with `-vvv`) and notably extracted the lines about the `space+k` request

<details><summary>~/.cache/helix/helix.log</summary>

```
2022-02-21T10:37:59.390 helix_lsp::transport [INFO] -> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/hover","params":{"position":{"character":8,"line":1},"textDocument":{"uri":"file:///home/alexis/repos/playground/src/main.rs"}},"id":1}
2022-02-21T10:37:59.392 helix_lsp::transport [INFO] <- {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"contents":{"kind":"markdown","value":"\n```rust\nlet a: i32\n```"},"range":{"start":{"line":1,"character":8},"end":{"line":1,"character":9}}}}
2022-02-21T10:37:59.392 helix_lsp::transport [INFO] <- {"contents":{"kind":"markdown","value":"\n```rust\nlet a: i32\n```"},"range":{"end":{"character":9,"line":1},"start":{"character":8,"line":1}}}
```

[helix.log](https://github.com/helix-editor/helix/files/8108105/helix.log)

</details>
